content.text:
Two night wakings at 19 months is common but fixable -- the usual culprit is a sleep-onset association, meaning Remy falls asleep one way (nursing, rocking) and needs that same thing when he surfaces between cycles. Start by putting him down drowsy but awake at bedtime so he learns to drift off independently, and when he wakes at night give him a beat before you go in.
